subject: Superintendent's 2020-2021 Performance Evaluation
overview: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent presented her self-evaluation for the 2020-2021 school year, highlighting pandemic response, technology equity, and professional goals. The committee discussed the evaluation timeline and approved a motion to formalize the review schedule for future years.

items.title: Superintendent's Self-Evaluation
items.summary: Superintendent Edouard-Vincent reviewed district accomplishments during the pandemic, including the implementation of COVID-19 testing, providing 1:1 technology for students, and completing the three-year New Superintendent Induction Program.

items.title: Committee Feedback and Future Evaluation Schedule
items.summary: Members praised the Superintendent's leadership during the school year and referred a motion to the rules subcommittee to establish a formalized timeline and advance notice requirements for future evaluation cycles. Approved.

items.title: Evaluation Logistics and Special Meeting Planning
items.summary: The committee coordinated the submission of individual evaluation rubrics by June 21 and discussed scheduling a special meeting to finalize the budget and the evaluation before the end of the fiscal year.

items.title: Correspondence
items.summary: Member Van der Kloot read a letter from resident Sean Began expressing support for the Superintendent's leadership.
